items.html: And it is simple that the posteriors of AVI did not finish descending until the end of the breaking of the seven vessels, for every phase of the breaking of the first king caused some of the posteriors of AVI to descend. And this is the explanation of the matter: When we consider the existence of these seven kings in the four Partzufim of HB, Yeshsut, and Tevuna, as was said above, it turns out that until a third of the Sefira of Tifferet, which is the fourth king, the posteriors of the upper AVI then finished descending, and when all seven kings broke, the posteriors of Yeshsut and Tevuna descended as well.
